rows: The terms are on the table. Read them and tell me where my claim goes wrong.
Brawling is a matter of record, and I have no complaint about the record.
A risk is a term too. Be clear about what you accept when you take it.
Pace is not a clause, so you cannot quietly change it.
The people are the party who pays. They are entitled to a clear account of what they get.
Short version: the terms say what they say, and I expect them to be honoured.
I am asking for the terms I was promised, nothing more and nothing less.
Look at the calm stance. It is what a careful reader looks like.
You claim technical skill. Name the hold, state what it requires, and then we can talk.
A brawl is not an argument. It is only noise until the terms are applied.
Risk is an exposure, and exposure should be priced. Yours has not been.
Stalling is a breach of pace. I will hold you to the timing.
The crowd rely on the result. Give them a result they can rely on.
You have described yourself as one of the best. Show the evidence and I will consider it.
You are proud of your {strength}. I have read it closely and I can state its terms.
I have read your {strength} as a condition of this match, and I intend to hold you to it.
A calm answer. Good, because calm is easier to hold to account.
Fair. That is the position on the record, and I am content to leave it there.
I could object to that. I would rather make the point in the ring.
One fall. Clean terms, clean finish. Keep me down and the result is yours.
On the mat, the terms are precise. Stay inside them, and so will I.
Grounded or standing, you will be held to the same rules.
Stay in front of me if you want to challenge the terms. I will read every one.
A fair answer. I will hold you to it.
You have had your reply. The question stands, and you have still not answered it.
Fair. That is on the record now.
I accept that for the moment, and I will come back to it at the bell.
I have stated the terms, and I will keep to them until the finish.
I am precise about my commitments, and I intend to keep them in the ring.
Whatever the result, the terms will be on record.
The matter is not closed. It is only postponed until the bell.
There is one term left to check. I think you already know which.
